ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the figure there are three cascaded T flip-flops, respectively labeled T0, T1, T2; each T input is connected to logic 1. The first stage is driven by the external CLK, and the clock input of the later stage is driven by the inverted output Q̅ of the previous stage, that is, Q̅0 is connected to the second-stage clock, and Q̅1 is connected to the third-stage clock; the outputs of each stage are respectively Q0, Q1, Q2. Reasoning: The present state Q2 Q1 Q0 = 011, so Q2=0, Q1=1, Q0=1. All T inputs are 1, therefore each flip-flop that is triggered by an effective positive edge will toggle. When the external positive clock edge arrives, the first-stage Q0 toggles from 1 to 0, therefore Q̅0 changes from 0 to 1, producing a rising edge and triggering the second stage. The second-stage Q1 toggles from 1 to 0, therefore Q̅1 changes from 0 to 1, producing a rising edge and triggering the third stage. The third-stage Q2 toggles from 0 to 1. Therefore the next state Q2 Q1 Q0 = 100.

raw_record.question_text: The given figure shows a ripple counter using positive edge-triggered flip-flops. If the present state of the counter is \(Q_2 Q_1 Q_0 = 011\), then what will the next state \(Q_2 Q_1 Q_0\) be?

method.method_draft: Starting from Q2 Q1 Q0 = 011, apply the next external positive clock edge to the first stage. Q0 toggles from 1 to 0, so \bar Q0 has a rising edge and clocks the second stage. Q1 toggles from 1 to 0, so \bar Q1 has a rising edge and clocks the third stage. Q2 toggles from 0 to 1. Therefore the next state is Q2 Q1 Q0 = 100.
method.CoT_raw: 图像描述：图中有三个级联的 T 触发器，分别标为 T0、T1、T2；每个 T 输入都接到逻辑 1。第一级由外部 CLK 驱动，后一级的时钟输入由前一级的反相输出 Q̅ 驱动，即 Q̅0 接到第二级时钟，Q̅1 接到第三级时钟；各级输出分别为 Q0、Q1、Q2。推理：现态 Q2 Q1 Q0 = 011，所以 Q2=0、Q1=1、Q0=1。所有 T 输入为 1，因此每个被有效正边沿触发的触发器都会翻转。外部正时钟沿到来时，第一级 Q0 从 1 翻转为 0，因此 Q̅0 从 0 变为 1，产生上升沿并触发第二级。第二级 Q1 从 1 翻转为 0，因此 Q̅1 从 0 变为 1，产生上升沿并触发第三级。第三级 Q2 从 0 翻转为 1。因此下一状态 Q2 Q1 Q0 = 100。
